title: Canonical oriented exchange coefficient-square assertion
statement: Fix a finite-field/coefficient purity setting $P$, put $s=\operatorname{Spec}(P.field.k)$, and let $a:X\to s$ be the structure map of a smooth separated finite-type scheme of pure dimension $d$. Use [def-pod-smooth-orientation-coefficient-family], [def-pod-smooth-orientation-transport-square], [def-pur-adic-purity-scalar-naturality-data], [def-sf-verdier-exchange-data], [fix-cor-verdier-exchange] and [def-weil-exceptional-adjoint-admissibility]. For a smooth structure map a:X->s=Spec(k), define the stage-exchange assertion on the recorded normalized systems for a,id_s and their composite in canonical compactification coordinates. Use the admissible exchange package and its prescribed compact-support, exceptional, internal-Hom and ordinary-direct-image comparisons. For each site-perfect K on X and admissible endpoint stages, put C=Ra_!K, K'=Q_XK, e=(recorded exchange)_K, u_Q=(compact-support q)_K, delta_{Q,C}=the evaluation-transposed point Hom map and R_Q=ordinary-direct-image comparison followed by the recorded dual Hom/dualizing comparison. Require the actual equation Q_s(e);R_Q=delta_{Q,C};D_s(u_Q^{-1});e' and the smooth-orientation transport equations into P'(K'). Forward and inverse purity squares use the specified source comparisons: finiteReductionSourceComparison, the fixed integral family's I.a, rationalSourceComparison, sourceScalar and commonSourceComparison. The comparisons are normalized to the recorded section/counit maps. This is an assertion predicate, not a proof of any square. The underlying constructions are those of [def-pod-integral-oriented-exchange-squares], [def-pod-field-oriented-exchange-squares].

reviewed_lean.note: 7th delivery addresses the earlier RETURNs. Statement, proof and proof_deps unchanged; only lean and stmt_deps added. Each node's lean.statement is verbatim in its file. Fixed I binder: its unit gamma is normalized to RationalSmoothPurityCanonical.orientation via sourceUnitIso (core.unit pinned by unit_formula), and its reductions are equated with the finite smoothPurityMap. Forward and inverse squares stated for finite, integral reduction, integral extension, rationalization, rational extension and common stage, with the canonical source maps and the q-mates b. Explicit exchange equation TY.map e ≫ R_Q = δ_{Q,C} ≫ D_s(u_Q⁻¹) ≫ e' for site-perfect K at every transition, with admissibility as hypotheses; e pinned by StageConclusion.components. Oriented square: θ=homX.map(𝟙,γ⁻¹), c_H and R_Q^H explicit, three step-6 equations. ∃Package/∃StageScalar accepted: q and unit pinned, FieldComparison.b determined by q, free tensor/pull harmless (exchangeNaturality holds for all b; transport reduces to the inverse purity square); same interface as the landed fix-cor-verdier-exchange. Edge cases d=0, m=n, exponent 1, Q̄_ℓ via the closed/common stages, nonproper X all covered. No hollow definition; only sorry is the main proof; docstrings carry source, blueprint tag and all six steps. Advisories: cor-pur-adic-and-rational-smooth-dualizing-complexes (owner of modelScalar/commonInclusion) cited only transitively; per-stage exchange squares use p.unit rather than the datum unit; maxHeartbeats raised to 1e6 in one module. No file changed, so no compile; the worker's per-file compiles and dry run were clean.
